prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: single finished wide landscape website product-card artwork for the Discord bot feature Voice Keeper.
Primary request: an exceptionally beautiful premium 3D product illustration communicating a friendly bot staying connected in a voice channel. Absolutely NO TEXT anywhere. Part of an established series with a white ceramic cute bot, obsidian glossy face, luminous cyan-blue square eyes, brushed silver details, ice-blue glass, and clean luminous studio.
Subject: ONE friendly floating bot head, white porcelain curved shell, glossy obsidian face, two softly luminous cyan rounded-square eyes, wearing beautifully designed over-ear headphones. Headphones have a pearl white headband, brushed aluminum supports and deep cobalt soft ear cushions, thin cyan luminous accents. The bot head hovers above a single low circular translucent ice-blue glass voice-channel platform; on this platform a subtle raised white 3D speaker pictogram with two curved sound-wave shapes, without letters. Two restrained spatial arcs of blue translucent sound waves frame the bot and headphones on either side, suggesting a quietly maintained voice connection. One small green status light on the platform indicates connected. Bot is the strong unmistakable focal point; the headphones must read instantly.
Scene: seamless near-white airy studio, very pale powder-blue gradient atmosphere, reflective matte white floor, gentle grounding shadows, a few tiny glass particles.
Composition: landscape 16:9 approximately 1672x941 or higher, centered sculptural composition filling 65% of frame width, full headphones and platform visible with generous safe margins. Three-quarter front view, charming deliberate professional design, balanced silhouette instantly recognizable at thumbnail size, upper-left corner quiet for an existing Featured overlay badge. No text column or typography space.
Style: high-end photorealistic CGI art direction, luxury product campaign materials, tactile white ceramic and brushed aluminum, beautiful ice-blue refractive glass, exquisite controlled specular highlights, wide softbox lighting from upper left, fine blue rim light, soft ray-traced contact shadows, restrained glow. Same calm white-and-blue visual language as a premium bot runtime hosting artwork, but this image focuses on voice connectivity rather than servers.
Constraints: NO text, letters, words, numerals, logo, watermark, UI, labels, card border or frame. No written labels on headphones. No server appliance. No people, hands, limbs, music notes, microphone for broadcasting, padlocks or shields. Do not suggest music playback or audio recording; emphasize listening and persistent connection. Avoid busy cyberpunk, excessive neon, dark background or clutter. Render artwork itself, not a mockup.
